when_wrong.detail: Anything but RS256 or PS256, exactly: the registration servlet fails on its first request

settings.name: acceptedSigningAlgorithms
settings.description: Which algorithms a presented chain's statements may use, comma-separated; unset, any asymmetric one

when_wrong.detail: An unknown algorithm matches no statement

settings.name: subordinateStatementCacheMaxEntries
settings.description: How many Subordinate Statements the registration servlet and filters keep; -1 is unbounded

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number, 0, or below -1: that component does not start

settings.name: trustChainEntryMaxAgeSeconds
settings.description: The oldest a statement in a presented trust chain may be

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number above 0: that component does not start

settings.name: trustControllerHost
settings.description: May name the trust controller only to agree with OIDF_FEDERATION_TRUST_CONTROLLER_HOST

when_wrong.detail: A different value: /federation/register fails on its first request

settings.name: trustControllerBaseUrl
settings.description: May name the controller's base URL only to agree with OIDF_FEDERATION_TRUST_CONTROLLER_BASE_URL

when_wrong.detail: A different value: /federation/register fails on its first request

settings.name: OIDF_REGISTERED_CLIENTS_ENABLED
settings.description: Turns on GET /federation/registered-clients, a list of the clients this module registered, behind the admin token; off, it answers 404

when_wrong.detail: Anything but true, in any case, means false

settings.name: OIDF_REGISTRATION_MAX_BODY_BYTES
settings.description: The largest request body POST /federation/register reads, in bytes (64 KiB by default, 4-512 KiB); a body declared or found larger is answered 413 with no more of it read

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number from 4096 to 524288: refused, naming the setting, on the first explicit registration request, which is answered 500

settings.name: OIDF_REGISTRATION_DEADLINE_SECONDS
settings.description: How long one registration - explicit, or automatic at the token, authorization or PAR endpoint - may take from asking to register: its wait for the client's lock plus its trust chain resolution, whose wall clock is OIDF_FEDERATION_RESOLUTION_WALL_CLOCK_SECONDS or what is left of this, whichever is shorter. Keep it under PingFederate's pf.runtime.http.idleTimeout (30000 ms by default) and any proxy's timeout; it must be longer than OIDF_AUTO_REGISTRATION_LOCK_WAIT_MS

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number of seconds from 2 to 300, or not longer than OIDF_AUTO_REGISTRATION_LOCK_WAIT_MS: /federation/register and the automatic-registration filters do not start
